_about: Behaviour changes that make results differ across commits. commit: first commit with the new behaviour.

entries.change: nevery is the source evaluation window; the window's markers are released over its steps (step 1 onward) instead of in one batch. nevery 1 keeps the previous random path.
New fix: gyromotion and reaction-interval monitor on CPU and Kokkos. Must follow every fix volume/chem/adas. Adds the per-particle attribute dtm_push.
An unusable database or table (wrong dimensions, missing axis, not HDF5) stops the run instead of falling back to the analytic model. Only an absent sputter table falls back, with a warning.
The per-window concentration snapshot is redone only when a wall model updated the concentrations: removes a per-window collective.
Cross-rank teleports through toroidal caps no longer lost with gridcut -1. Earlier multi-rank wedge runs lost markers at caps.
